H1-P4s: In the villages and families I've spent time around, a lot of what we'd be trying to "re-invent" with intentional community is still part of daily life. Land, childcare, housing, food, obligations, etc. etc. often get taken care of by the extended family and local memory, in addition to the formal systems. Who needs a workshop called "Rebuilding Intergenerational Belonging" when some aunt has already given three people a task?
